name: Felipe Espinosa
description: AI research engineer working on deep learning, resource-efficient AI, robot learning, world models, multimodal learning, and agentic systems.
about: I am an AI research engineer based in Paris with a background in electronic engineering and a Master's degree in Artificial Intelligence from Université Paris-Saclay. My current research interests are resource-efficient machine learning, robot learning, world models, multimodal learning, and agentic AI.

My recent work spans deep learning for under-resourced speech synthesis, agent-based systems for structured-data analysis, and mobile robotics. I am particularly interested in how increasingly capable learning-based models can be made practical for deployment on resource-constrained robotic platforms.
vision: My long-term research goal is to develop learning-based systems that can operate effectively on real robotic platforms. I am particularly interested in how model design, adaptive computation, and efficient representations can preserve task performance while reducing the memory, latency, and energy requirements of deployed AI systems.

teaching: Through UIS's PAMRA academic-support program, I completed approximately 400 hours of individual and group mathematics and physics tutoring for university students, including sessions with more than 50 students. I also prepared exercises and class materials aligned with university course programs in coordination with other tutors and the program coordinator.
